findings.details: Overtime records require additional review before audit closure.
findings.rootCause: Working hour monitoring process is not consistently reviewed by the responsible owner.
findings.correctiveAction: Improve weekly overtime review, approval control, and escalation process.
findings.evidence: Attendance report, overtime approval, weekly review record, corrective action evidence

findings.requirement: Wage payment evidence and employee acknowledgement
findings.details: Some wage payment evidence requires clearer traceability.
findings.rootCause: Payroll evidence retention is not aligned with audit retrieval needs.
findings.correctiveAction: Create a monthly payroll evidence checklist and assign document control owner.
findings.evidence: Payroll report, bank transfer record, acknowledgement evidence, checklist

findings.details: Age verification control was reviewed and corrected.
findings.rootCause: Recruitment checklist did not explicitly separate age verification evidence.
findings.correctiveAction: Revise recruitment checklist and train recruitment staff.
findings.evidence: Updated checklist, ID copy control, training record, audit sample

findings.details: Contractor evidence is incomplete for some service providers.
findings.rootCause: Supplier onboarding process does not require complete labour compliance evidence before approval.
findings.correctiveAction: Add labour compliance evidence requirement into supplier onboarding and annual review.
findings.evidence: Supplier checklist, contractor worker list, wage evidence, legal compliance declaration

findings.details: Training coverage requires update for new employees.
findings.rootCause: New employee training schedule is not fully linked to compliance training matrix.
findings.correctiveAction: Update training matrix and add monthly new employee compliance orientation.
findings.evidence: Training matrix, attendance record, training material, post-test result
